expected_behavior: Scope questions reach the user as panels, one at a time, covering audience, entities, use cases, auth, pagination, rate limits and versioning; none are asked in prose.
save-design.mjs creates the draft file and prints its path; the agent then writes the body into that file.
Running the same topic twice produces a second timestamped draft instead of overwriting the first.
The draft lists endpoints, data models, auth and error cases in markdown a person can review before any OpenAPI is generated.
